findings.summary: Commit b94e362 synced Order of work step 2, Risks items 1-2 and the Proof section to "nine fail cases" naming the new supersedes-shape case, but left two "Files that change" bullets untouched: the `plugin/gate/checks.py` bullet (lines 30-46, listing the glob-match, missing-field, eval-file, index-check, dangling-supersedes, not-retired and out-of-enum cases but not the supersedes-shape case added in PR #132) and the `tests/test_gate.py` bullet (lines 86-101, same omission) still read as if only eight fail cases exist.
findings.rule: REVIEW.md framework rule: "plan.md must reflect the diff: ... A diff that departs from the plan without a plan.md update in the same commit is non-compliant." (Second occurrence of this exact finding type on this change — at commit b0e778a5 the same rule was broken for Risk 2/Order of work/Proof/spec.md Acceptance; worth a CLAUDE.md "Things Claude gets wrong" line: "Fixing a stale plan.md enumeration: re-grep every occurrence of the changed count/list across the whole file (including the 'Files that change' section), not just the locations a prior review named.")

findings.summary: The `tests/test_lessons.py` "Files that change" bullet still says only "a malformed frontmatter file listed under `## Unsorted`", not mentioning the non-UTF-8-file and bad-shaped-`detected.at`/`stale_after` cases that the Proof section (and spec.md) now name and that `tests/test_lessons.py` actually covers.
findings.rule: doubt stated: cosmetic staleness in a bullet that still names the module and the general `## Unsorted` behavior correctly

findings.summary: `build()` (and therefore `check()`) always runs `lessons_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`, so the read-only `check` (and `lesson_and_eval`'s call to it) creates `lessons/` as a side effect; carried over from the prior review round (owner's fix-requests.json item 7, deferred to 0.3.7), still present at this HEAD.
findings.rule: doubt stated: low impact (an untracked empty directory is never committed), but every other gate check in plugin/gate/checks.py is read-only on the filesystem

findings.summary: `_render_line`'s `Tags:` clause joins the raw `fm["tags"]` list as written, while the heading grouping uses `normalise_class(e.tags[0])`; an unnormalised class (e.g. "Flaky Test") renders under heading `## flaky-test` with a line that still reads `Tags: Flaky Test, ...`; owner's fix-requests.json item 5, deferred to 0.3.7, still present.
findings.rule: doubt stated: owner already triaged this as can-wait; spec.md's determinism bullet is the rule it falls short of

findings.summary: `_render_line`/`_render_unsorted_line` interpolate `title`/`description`/the first heading into a markdown link with no escaping, so a value containing `]` or `(` would break the generated link in `lessons/index.md`; carried over unaddressed from the prior review round.
findings.rule: doubt stated: spec.md's determinism bullet does not call for escaping, and no source file or test exercises such a title today

findings.summary: `from lessons import index as lessons_mod` is imported separately in both `_supersedes_problem` (line 1616) and `lesson_and_eval` (line 1644) instead of once and passed through; carried over unaddressed from the prior review round.
